evidence: The Ga2O3–TiO2 films were prepared using PEALD with an alternating supply of CH3GaNH2, O2 plasma, Ti(NCH3)2 and O2 plasma. One deposition cycle consists of four pulses: CH3GaNH2 or Ti(NCH3)2 vapor pulse with 100 sccm Ar carrier gas for 0.1 s, Ar purge gas pulse for 2 s, O2 plasma gas pulse for 1 s, Ar purge gas pulse for 0.4 s.
